narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I checked the production logs this morning and the drift detection job has not executed in forty-five days. The cron entry is commented out in the scheduler config, so no alerts are generated when input distributions shift. I manually inspected the feature store yesterday and noticed the mean value for the customer tenure column had drifted by two standard deviations, but nothing flagged it automatically. The dashboard still shows green status indicators because the health check only verifies that the service container is running, not that the monitoring logic is active. I have been reviewing the raw data exports by hand to catch obvious anomalies, but that process takes about an hour each day and only covers the top five features.
output.reclassify_reason: The text consists entirely of observational statements regarding the current operational status, such as the disabled cron job, the specific data drift observed, and the limitations of the manual review process, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or explicit trade-offs.
